reasons: Inherited recipe re-executed unmodified against branch + origin/main@9e713efc26 (dist rebuilt at HEAD eaa84b92d4): summary.json status pass, 22/22 nodes, failed 0.

AC3 divergence still reproduces live and read-only on the merged tree: streamedAccountPresent=false ('0') vs fresh perpsGetAccountState '756.36175', decisions disagree on a $378 withdrawal (blocked vs allowed).
AC1/AC2 asserted by strict eq on jest JSON (4 and 5 passing cases, 0 failures), with matched-case counts asserted so an empty jest filter cannot pass silently.

The rebase conflicts that could have weakened the proof were resolved in favour of main's intent and re-verified: dropping 'use no memo' left the hook on standard hooks only (its suite already uses renderHookWithConfirmContextProvider), and the added/added test collision kept both AccountNoFunds and PerpsWithdrawBalanceUnavailable cases, both green.
Screenshot captured via capture-helper snapshot with no fallback (artifact-manifest.json).
Confirmation-screen screenshot remains UNTESTABLE for infrastructure reasons only (EVM RPC in the slot fails with an unbound-fetch 'Illegal invocation'), and no AC depends on it.

graph_integrity.reason: Single linear workflow, every node reachable from setup-status, terminal teardown-done reached with status pass; no switch, no wait, no manual action. Dry-run with --plan validated 22 nodes before the live run.

action_contract.reason: Only manifest-declared actions used (app.status, cdp.target, metamask.wallet.ensure_unlocked, ui.navigate, ui.wait_for, ui.screenshot, command, assert_json, end); runner v1 validation passed and reported no unknown params.

ac_coverage.reason: Every AC maps to ac<N>-* nodes with at least one strict assertion, and each test-backed AC also asserts the matched-case count (4 for AC1, 5 for AC2, 1 for AC3).

evidence_contract_basics.reason: Hidden hook/controller claims are proven by test and live state artifacts; the single screenshot is preceded by ui.wait_for on its claimed target (matched true, 3.8s) and is used for orientation only. artifact-manifest.json records provider capture-helper, mode snapshot, fallbackFrom absent, so it is not a silent Page.captureScreenshot fallback.

perps_state_setup.reason: Required Perps state (funded testnet account, then an empty streamed cache) is built by the recipe itself: setup-warm-streamed-cache opens Perps, setup-leave-perps returns to a non-Perps screen, and the probe restarts the UI realm so the cache is deterministically empty while the fresh balance stays 756.36175.

mobile_alignment.reason: Unchanged by this run. Mobile's useWithdrawValidation validates against usePerpsLiveAccount (a live subscription); the Extension alert runs for every confirmation type, so the fix uses a perpsWithdraw-gated fresh perpsGetAccountState read as the equivalent, keeping non-Perps confirmations free of Perps traffic.

contextual_findings.message: Unchanged from the parent run: the MM Pay Perps withdraw confirmation cannot be opened in this slot because createPerpsWithdrawTransaction needs Arbitrum gas estimation and every EVM RPC call fails with "Failed to execute 'fetch' on 'WorkerGlobalScope': Illegal invocation". AC3 is therefore proven by live state probe plus hook test, which the AC explicitly allows.

This pass re-validates an unchanged fix on a new merge base, so no baseline (pre-fix) recipe was re-run and evidence-manifest.json carries no before/after pair. The parent run's recipe-baseline.json remains the before-evidence. If the fix itself is ever edited, the baseline must be re-run rather than inherited.

suggested_recipe_delta: Once EVM RPC works in the slot, extend the recipe with ac3-open-withdraw-confirmation / ac3-set-amount / ac3-assert-blocking-alert nodes to capture the confirmation screen itself, replacing the orientation screenshot with a real before/after of the blocking alert.

Add a cheap guard node asserting the hook source contains no 'use no memo' directive, so a future merge that reintroduces it (undoing #45257's React Compiler opt-in) fails the recipe instead of passing silently.
